finalCampaignOutcome: pending; this visual audit is not a suite pass or release verdict
fixtureBoundaries: CardDeletion PNGs use NSView.cacheDisplay on a 980-by-900-point offscreen component host. Their 1960-by-1800 pixels include transparent areas; they are not whole production-window screenshots.
Project-note/search-note/hour components use explicit 360/360/430-point widths. Trash/comment components occupy the wider host. No compact 380-point Trash-layout claim follows.

CardDeletion mount only sets tooltip and animation options. The directly mounted comment panel lacks BoardView foregroundStyle, tint, accent injection, board background and preferredColorScheme setup.

The isolated comment bitmap contrast problem is an evidence limitation. Parent-reported actual current-baseline Board interaction showed a legible purple selected Comments label and successfully activated enabled Post; manual-session.json independently records native posting. No new production contrast failure is claimed.
None of the five CardDeletion PNGs shows a native confirmation sheet. Tests activate confirmation buttons, but alert layout/wording is not visually certified by these images.
Header findings concern only the four named PNGs and captured widths/themes/states. Scrollable content outside each captured viewport is not a clipping defect.

PNG hashes identify exactly the reviewed bytes. They do not independently bind those pixels to every input of a final campaign; final input/cache/live-source provenance remains a separate root verification.
These images do not establish physical hit delivery, VoiceOver speech/action rotor, every text length or locale, system contrast/text scaling, signed/sandboxed readiness, installation or release.

The reviewed PNG bytes are preserved under visual-review-inputs so later test rerenders cannot overwrite the visual evidence; hashes refer to these preserved copies as well as source paths at preservation time.

images.finding: Four removed-item cards have readable distinct Restore and Delete permanently controls, with no visible overlap or clipping. Wide fixture only; compact Trash layout is not established.

Composer and two saved comments are readable; pencil and trash controls remain unobstructed. Selected Comments and enabled Post labels are low contrast or absent in this isolated bitmap; no production defect inferred.
The explicit 430-point hourly card shows its count, interval, three visible captures and complete More/trash controls without clipping.
The explicit 360-point project-note card has readable wrapped body, project name, type/date and complete More control without clipping.
The explicit 360-point search-note card has readable wrapped text and complete project/Edit/Copy/More controls without clipping.
At 380-point board width, header controls, Projects/Tasks/Captions navigation, timeline controls, visible capture card and footer are legible and contained.
At 380-point dark Settings width, header/category/export/deleted-item controls are legible and contained. Lower content ends at the viewport; this is not full Storage content evidence.

At 380-by-430-point board size, search field/filter controls/date headings remain legible. Lower result content is cropped by the scroll viewport above the footer, not evidence of a fixed-card overlap.
At 380-point dark Settings width, source consent wording and Clipboard/Screenshots switches are legible and contained. Lower content ends at the viewport.

method: Read existing PNGs with view_image, then inspect snapshot source and retained evidence; no source/test writes or workloads during this audit.
preservationStatus: preserved; all nine copies reinspected with view_image and their recorded hashes verified
productionFinding: No additional reproduced production usability defect from this visual audit.
